query:
UPDATE site_settings
SET settingValue = 'MATERIAL PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Material Purchase Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of the date signed below, between the customer identified above ("Buyer") and Design Your Price / Tanzite Stone Decking ("Seller").

SCOPE OF WORK
Seller agrees to supply and, where applicable, install the materials and services described in the Estimate Breakdown above for the property address provided. The scope includes all line items listed in the Estimate Breakdown, which may include: decking materials, edge materials, labor, delivery, demolition of existing structures, deck framing, subfloor installation (required for Rainier waterproof deck systems to ensure proper drainage and structural integrity), RainEscape waterproofing system components, accessories, and applicable taxes and permits.

SUBFLOOR INSTALLATION (RAINIER PROJECTS)
For projects utilizing the Tanzite Rainier Collection, a subfloor system is required as part of the installation. The subfloor provides the structural substrate and waterproofing interface necessary for the Rainier system to perform as warranted. The subfloor line item is included in the Estimate Breakdown and is non-negotiable for Rainier installations.

PAYMENT TERMS
A deposit equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Total Estimate is due upon signing this Agreement and is collected via the secure Stripe payment link provided after signing. The remaining balance of fifty percent (50%) is due upon delivery and/or completion of installation, as agreed between Buyer and Seller.

MATERIAL DELIVERY
Seller will coordinate delivery of materials to the address provided. Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to availability, weather, or logistics. Seller will notify Buyer of any material delays.

CANCELLATION POLICY
Buyer may cancel this Agreement within 72 hours of signing for a full refund of the deposit. Cancellations after 72 hours are subject to a restocking fee of up to 25% of the deposit amount if materials have been ordered or reserved.

WARRANTY
Materials are warranted per the manufacturer specifications. Labor warranty, if applicable, is provided separately in writing. Seller makes no additional warranties beyond those provided by the manufacturer.

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Seller liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid by Buyer. Seller is not liable for incidental, consequential, or indirect damages arising from the use or installation of materials.

GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Utah. Any disputes arising under this Agreement shall be resolved in the courts of Utah County, Utah.

ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement, together with the Estimate Breakdown above, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or agreements. Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.

By signing below, Buyer acknowledges having read, understood, and agreed to all terms of this Agreement.'
WHERE settingKey = 'contract_text'
